name: Shunju Sengoku
source:
Main protagonist.
A prisoner of Team Mass Murderers. Sentence: 999 years.

Sengoku was imprisoned for a murder case in which 21 people burned to death. He is sociable and considerate. He has protested his innocence for over 10 years, and vows to emerge from the Yurukill Games victorious with his teammate, Rina.
